data.name: Arohan
data.gender_notes: Arohan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aroha’ which means ‘progress’ or ‘advancement’. This name signifies the upward journey of the soul towards spiritual growth and self-realization. It is believed to bring success, prosperity, and good fortune to the one who bears this name. The name Arohan carries the meaning “Progress, advancement” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arohan usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, advancement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual growth and self-realization
data.etymology: Arohan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Progress, advancement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arohan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
